# `m.crypto.snapshots`

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

The current state of crypto pairs: today's, the last minute's, and yesterday's bars.

```python
m.crypto.snapshots(symbols)
```

[All datasets](README.md)

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Verbs | `fetch()`, `poll()` |
| Served by | REST |
| `poll()` | `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`: holds exactly the latest cycle's rows, keyed by `Symbol`; `mode=dm.PollMode.APPEND` also keys by `Updated` |

## Arguments

What each argument does for this dataset, and the rule it follows for every dataset that takes it.

| Argument | For this dataset | For every dataset |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `symbols` | Crypto pairs as Massive's tickers, such as `X:BTCUSD`, or `dm.ALL` for every traded pair. | Massive's ticker for each symbol, spelled exactly as Massive spells it: `AAPL` or `BRK.B` for a stock, `O:SPY271217C00700000` (the OCC code) for an option, `I:SPX` for an index, `C:EURUSD` for a forex pair, `X:BTCUSD` for a crypto pair, and `ESZ6` for a future. Pass one symbol as text, several as a list, or a table with a `Symbol` column. A live table is followed: each symbol you add is read, and the rows of each one you delete leave the table. `dm.ALL` reads every symbol, and leaving the argument out reads every record with no filter by symbol, where this dataset takes them. A misspelled symbol in text or a list raises `ValueError` at the call; a misspelled row of a table is skipped and logged, and the table keeps running. `dm.canonical_symbol` converts other spellings to Massive's. A record that lists several symbols, such as a news article, appears once for each symbol you named that it lists. |

## Plan access

Which of Massive's plans include this dataset, how recent its data is on each, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Full Market Snapshot (REST) |
| --- | --- |
| Currencies Basic | Not included |
| Currencies Starter | Real-time |
| Currencies Business | Real-time |

## Columns

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. From REST `ticker`: "The exchange symbol that this item is traded under." | REST |
| `RawSymbol` | String | The symbol exactly as Massive sent it, on a row whose spelling the library cannot read as the dataset's class (its `Symbol` is then null); null on every other row. Present unless the session's `unreadable_symbols` is `dm.OnError.RAISE`, which fails on such a row instead. | REST |
| `DayOpen` | double | The open price for the symbol in the given time period. From the `day` object: The most recent daily bar for this ticker. | REST |
| `DayHigh` | double | The highest price for the symbol in the given time period. From the `day` object: The most recent daily bar for this ticker. | REST |
| `DayLow` | double | The lowest price for the symbol in the given time period. From the `day` object: The most recent daily bar for this ticker. | REST |
| `DayClose` | double | The close price for the symbol in the given time period. From the `day` object: The most recent daily bar for this ticker. | REST |
| `DayVolume` | double | The trading volume of the symbol in the given time period. From the `day` object: The most recent daily bar for this ticker. | REST |
| `DayVwap` | double | The volume weighted average price. From the `day` object: The most recent daily bar for this ticker. | REST |
| `Fmv` | double | Fair market value is only available on Business plans. It is our proprietary algorithm to generate a real-time, accurate, fair market value of a tradable security. For more information, contact us (https://massive.com/contact). | REST |
| `LastTradePrice` | double | The price of the trade: the amount of the pair's second currency paid for one unit of its first (US dollars per bitcoin for X:BTCUSD). From the `lastTrade` object: The most recent trade for this ticker. | REST |
| `LastTradeSize` | double | The size (volume) of the trade. From the `lastTrade` object: The most recent trade for this ticker. | REST |
| `LastTradeConditions` | long[] | A list of condition codes. See Crypto Condition Codes (https://massive.com/docs/rest/crypto/market-operations/condition-codes) for what each code means. From the `lastTrade` object: The most recent trade for this ticker. | REST |
| `LastTradeId` | String | The Trade ID which uniquely identifies a trade on the exchange that the trade happened on. From the `lastTrade` object: The most recent trade for this ticker. | REST |
| `LastTradeParticipantTimestamp` | Instant | The millisecond accuracy timestamp. This is the timestamp of when the trade was generated at the exchange. From the `lastTrade` object: The most recent trade for this ticker. | REST |
| `LastTradeExchange` | long | The exchange that this crypto trade happened on. See Exchanges (https://massive.com/docs/rest/crypto/market-operations/exchanges) for a mapping of exchanges to IDs. From the `lastTrade` object: The most recent trade for this ticker. | REST |
| `LastMinuteOpen` | double | The open price for the symbol in the given time period. From the `min` object: The most recent minute bar for this ticker. | REST |
| `LastMinuteHigh` | double | The highest price for the symbol in the given time period. From the `min` object: The most recent minute bar for this ticker. | REST |
| `LastMinuteLow` | double | The lowest price for the symbol in the given time period. From the `min` object: The most recent minute bar for this ticker. | REST |
| `LastMinuteClose` | double | The close price for the symbol in the given time period. From the `min` object: The most recent minute bar for this ticker. | REST |
| `LastMinuteVolume` | double | The trading volume of the symbol in the given time period. From the `min` object: The most recent minute bar for this ticker. | REST |
| `LastMinuteVwap` | double | The volume weighted average price. From the `min` object: The most recent minute bar for this ticker. | REST |
| `LastMinuteTransactions` | long | The number of transactions in the aggregate window. From the `min` object: The most recent minute bar for this ticker. | REST |
| `LastMinuteWindowStart` | Instant | The Unix millisecond timestamp for the start of the aggregate window. From the `min` object: The most recent minute bar for this ticker. | REST |
| `PrevDayOpen` | double | The open price for the symbol in the given time period. From the `prevDay` object: The previous day's bar for this ticker. | REST |
| `PrevDayHigh` | double | The highest price for the symbol in the given time period. From the `prevDay` object: The previous day's bar for this ticker. | REST |
| `PrevDayLow` | double | The lowest price for the symbol in the given time period. From the `prevDay` object: The previous day's bar for this ticker. | REST |
| `PrevDayClose` | double | The close price for the symbol in the given time period. From the `prevDay` object: The previous day's bar for this ticker. | REST |
| `PrevDayVolume` | double | The trading volume of the symbol in the given time period. From the `prevDay` object: The previous day's bar for this ticker. | REST |
| `PrevDayVwap` | double | The volume weighted average price. From the `prevDay` object: The previous day's bar for this ticker. | REST |
| `TodaysChange` | double | The value of the change from the previous day. | REST |
| `TodaysChangePerc` | double | The percentage change since the previous day. | REST |
| `Updated` | Instant | The last updated timestamp. | REST |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant: the local clock when the REST page, flat-file block, or WebSocket frame that carried it arrived, the same for every row of one. It is not monotonic and is not Massive's own receive time; on history() rows it is the download time, and in a poll() table the latest poll's. | REST |
